deps.edn.reason: The git floors and pins on repositories that are bundled here become local roots so the same namespaces are not loaded twice. The other sections are unchanged. JVM-only Maven dependencies and aliases are removed (dep org.clojure/clojure, dep org.clojure/clojurescript, dep thheller/shadow-cljs, alias :build, alias :test reduced to :extra-paths): the official CD/CI path is Amu selfhost and Kotoba native, and any other runner is an oracle that is not part of the package.
